en.sayed-ali-raza: His words “ḥadābiru's-sinin”. This is plural of “hidbar” It means the camel whom treading has made thin. So Amīr al-mu’minīn likened with such or camel the year in which drought had occurred.
The Arab poet Dhū ar-Rummah has said: These thin camels remain in their places, facing hardships and move only when we take them to some dry area.
